branch.description: Optional branch name to create for the worktree

exposes_tools.name: git_commit
exposes_tools.description: Lower git commit into a forge action

message.description: Commit message to pass to git commit

idem.description: Idempotency key for the commit action

branch.description: Optional branch name expected after committing

exposes_tools.name: gh_pr_list
exposes_tools.description: Lower GitHub pull request overlap scans into a forge action

repo.description: Repository git-dir path or selector passed to gh/git

base.description: Base branch to filter pull requests

head.description: Head branch to filter pull requests

exposes_tools.name: gh_pr_diff
exposes_tools.description: Read a GitHub pull request's net diff of base_sha...head_sha (merge base to head), pinned to those commits rather than the PR's current head. The call waits and returns result.event.artifact_path, the file holding the diff

repo.description: Repository git-dir path or selector passed to gh/git

pr.description: Pull request number; labels the read, does not select or check the commits

base_sha.description: Full base commit SHA; the diff starts at its merge base with head_sha

head_sha.description: Full head commit SHA whose diff is read

exposes_tools.name: gh_pr_checks
exposes_tools.description: Park this call to wait for a pull request's checks on its current head. By default return on the first failure; wait_for_all=true waits for every registered check to finish. A conflicting PR, changed head or deadline also ends the wait. The forge.pr.checks wake records the exact head, CI conclusion, mergeability, whether all checks completed, and failed check locators with available failure steps, error summaries and verified Actions job log links or an explicit diagnostic unavailability reason. While pending, repeating the same call returns the same receipt. After the wake, repeat the same call to read the recorded result. Replay is for same-key calls across program versions: the key encodes repo, pr, attempt and wait_for_all injectively for calls made from this version on, and a call stored by an earlier version is not replayed but starts a fresh read. Historical results retain their original fields. For fresh checks pass a new attempt. After any rerun of a workflow run, including one the user starts, wait with after_rerun: the run's checks stay pending until it reports a later attempt that completed, so the rerun attempt's stale failure cannot end the wait; failures of other runs still do, and a run that is not of the PR head is refused (the call fails).

repo.description: Repository git-dir path or selector passed to gh/git

wait_for_all.description: Wait for every registered check to complete before returning the failure collection; default returns on the first failure

after_rerun.description: The GitHub Actions run that was rerun and the attempt that failed: its checks count as pending until the run reports a later, completed attempt

run_attempt.description: The run attempt that failed and was rerun

exposes_tools.name: gh_ci_failure_evidence
exposes_tools.description: Read failure evidence of the GitHub Actions runs of one exact head: at most 4 completed, unsuccessful runs whose head_sha and repository match, at most 8 of their attempts' failed, timed-out or cancelled jobs with conclusion, failed steps and link, and each job's log tail (the last 200 lines, at most 16 KiB, sanitized line by line; log.truncated when cut) or log.status unavailable with a reason. A run is stale when its attempt changed during the read; truncated means a run, job or failed step was left out. The call waits and returns result.event.artifact_path, the JSON file holding the evidence; log text is never in the event or result. Repeating the same call replays the stored read; pass a new attempt for fresh evidence

repo.description: Repository git-dir path or selector passed to gh/git

pr.description: Pull request number; labels the read, does not select the runs

head_sha.description: Full head commit SHA whose Actions runs are read

attempt.description: Optional read attempt identifier; a new one reads fresh evidence

exposes_tools.name: gh_issue_search
exposes_tools.description: Search issues (not PRs), returning JSON number/url/state/title/body/labels. Bounded search is not a recovery oracle. Reuse attempt to replay, change it to refresh.

repo.description: Repository git-dir path or selector passed to gh/git
